name: ai-subtitle-remover
description: Remove image watermarks, local video subtitles or visual watermarks, and platform watermarks from copied video links with the 550W Open API

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild dist/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/550w-skill.cjs && esbuild dist/mcp-server.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/550w-mcp.cjs && esbuild dist/oauth-upload-cli.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/550w-upload.cjs
